name: TNF receptor associated factor 5
pathways: regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: TRAF5 encodes TNF receptor-associated factor 5. Annotated molecular activities include signaling adaptor activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
